approved_scope: Retained original 53 historical quality arrays attached to proven equal native YUV and billed delivered MKV bytes only.
decision_authority: Root scientific decision, 2026-11-05; existing full22 cost failure remains in force.
method: Independently rehashed nine ready/spec/dispatch records, original published score archives, all 53 arrays, and actual MKV/proof/independent-validation members. Compared 9 archived same-native controls across A6000 and Ada.

required_sensitivity.scope: explicit final-conclusion sensitivity only; not a statistical guarantee or a relaxation of existing gates

limitations: Historical RGB bytes were not saved; equality of newly rendered RGB is an inference, not an independent measurement.
Native-YUV proof does not establish fresh neural scores or deterministic cross-GPU results.
Paired control differences do not bound all rows or substitute for final sensitivity.
Costs and quality of any future points need separate admission.
